material.description: Symptom: the game-start screen is ugly and confusing. Current lobby_tree (scenarios/moba/panels.lua ~772-802) renders two team columns of seats, a text-name grid for heroes, and Fill/Start buttons. Target, from the reference screenshot: (1) top strip, one portrait+name seat per player per team, team-coloured bars; (2) centre hero grid of portraits grouped in rows by primary attribute, labelled Strength, Agility, Intelligence; (3) right card 'Choose your hero' with the picked hero's portrait, name, stat bars, Lock In and Random; (4) bottom bar with team composition, status, Fill with bots and Start match. Data: attribute groups derive from scenarios/moba/heroes_688g.tsv (UnitBalance base and gains: the primary attribute is the largest gain; do not invent one). Role tags (Nuker, Disabler, Jungler, Durable, Escape, Pusher, Initiator) are NOT in 6.88g: render them as the label UNVERIFIED, never filled from Dota 2 (AGENTS.md 6.88g precedence). Ownership: scenarios/moba/panels.lua and scenarios/moba/moba_ui.json (TEXT keys only). Keep lobby actions claim, release, pick, ready, fill, start and their refusals unchanged (lobby_act). hero_icon (panels.lua:116) draws the portraits. Acceptance: the tree has the four regions; every roster hero has a portrait slot; panels_route and lobby_claim tests stay green in CI. Witness: CI green on the pushed sha. Browser look is blocked (browser stall) and is not this row's witness.
